settings.media_interval.label: Media poll interval
settings.media_interval.description: How often the media widget asks media-player for its state, in milliseconds.
settings.tailscale_interval.label: Tailscale poll interval
settings.tailscale_interval.description: How often the Tailscale widget asks tailscale-status for its state, in milliseconds.
settings.ipad_interval.label: iPad poll interval
settings.ipad_interval.description: How often the iPad widget asks ipad-display for its state, in milliseconds.
settings.temporal_interval.label: Temporal poll interval
settings.temporal_interval.description: How often the Temporal widget probes 192.168.6.20:7233, in milliseconds.
settings.thermostat_interval.label: Thermostat poll interval
settings.thermostat_interval.description: How often the thermostat widget asks Home Assistant for the bedroom climate state, in milliseconds.
settings.vast_interval.label: VAST poll interval
settings.vast_interval.description: How often the VAST widget refreshes its instance, tunnel and vLLM state, in milliseconds.
settings.updates_interval.label: flake.lock poll interval
settings.updates_interval.description: How often the updates widget checks the age of ~/dotfiles/flake.lock, in milliseconds.
settings.terminal.label: Terminal for nix flake update
settings.terminal.description: Terminal command to run the update in. Empty lets Noctalia pick one ($TERMINAL, then the first terminal found on PATH).
